newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Banks to put Hanbo up for open auction.
newsitem.headline: Banks to put Hanbo up for open auction.

text.p: Creditor banks of South Korea's Hanbo Steel Co plan to put the troubled steelmaker up for sale through a public auction, officials at the prime creditor bank said on Thursday.
"We plan to sell Hanbo Steel through a public auction because that appears to be the best way," said an official of the Korea First Bank, the main creditor bank.
"But no time schedule has been set for the auction."
The officials said if the first auction fails to find a new owner, the creditor banks would hold additional auctions.
"If that doesn't work out, we'll seek a third-party takeover of Hanbo Steel through private negotiations with interested parties," the official said.
Hanbo Steel, the flagship of Hanbo Group, went insolvent in January after piling up $5.8 billion in debt.
